title: 14th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/14/2/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 7/2/2026 to 9/2/2026).

Question by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Fisheries, Agriculture and Ocean Resources Ahmed Shiyam: on 11 August 2025 President Dr Mohamed Muizzu visited B. Kudarikilu and assured residents his pledges would be met; on what date is the practical work to set up the promised ice plant in Kudarikilu scheduled to start?
Continuation of the debate on the bill to amend the Waste Management Act (Law No. 24/2022), submitted on behalf of the government by Ungoofaaru MP Ibrahim Shifaz.

Continuation of the debate on the resolution submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir noting that, under the name of reducing staff at state-owned companies, many people are being dismissed from their jobs for political reasons, and seeking the views of Parliament's members on the matter.
Report of the Social Affairs Committee on the Human Organ Transplant Bill, which the President returned to Parliament for reconsideration under Article 91(a) of the Constitution.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took a question on the Kudarikilu ice plant, continued debating the Waste Management Act amendment and a resolution on political dismissals at state companies, and received the committee report on the returned Human Organ Transplant Bill.
